answer: Cosignatures are collected in bridge, verified in delta, and prism names every witness. Each submission needs cosignature from 2 independent nodes that observed it arrive, and a node cannot cosign more than 24 submissions per epoch. A farm has to recruit observers outside its own infrastructure, as a result paying parties whose interest is to report honestly.
